# =============================================================================
# tessera-term: rectangular area operations DECERA / DECFRA / DECCRA / DECSERA   (issue #251, wave 20)
# spec-researcher output, 2026-11-13, lifted from the wave-20 staging file; run by tests/rect.rs (132 cases, whole and byte by byte; ADR 0046).
#
# FORMAT  Same layout as protect_spec.txt / csi_spec.txt (### ID / size / step / screen / cursor / pending_wrap / requests / scrollback), read by
#   tests/spec/mod.rs parse_fixture; `|` is placed AFTER the cursor's cell (render_screen); a wide glyph is one character (spacer not drawn); `\` after a
#   row marks a soft-wrapped line. `\e` ESC, `\r\n`; wide characters appear as raw scalars (the harness decode must keep them, else write \u{6F22}).
#   Extra keys: `pstate: mode/pen` (as protect_spec.txt, asserted by tests/protect.rs only), `attr: (row,c0)-(row,c1) fg=.. bg=.. ul=- us=.. flags=..`
#   (esctest.rs notation: colours `i<n>`, flags `bold,...`), `xterm_screen:` / `xterm_attr:` = what a stock xterm (snapshot master, 2026-11-13) produces when it differs
#   from the recommended row (the row's own `screen:` is the RECOMMENDATION), `xterm: identical`, `flags:` = decision | xterm-differs | xterm-quirk | xterm-extension | control.
#   Row ids: RE DECERA, RF DECFRA, RC DECCRA, RS DECSERA, RO origin mode/margins, RG level gate, RW wide cells, RH other.
#
# HOW THE ROWS WERE PRODUCED  A Python model of xterm (screen.c xtermParseRect/validRect/ScrnFillRectangle/ScrnCopyRectangle/ScrnWipeRectangle, charproc.c CASE_DEC*)
#   with the #251 planning decisions applied, byte streams run through it and rendered in render_screen notation. The model reproduces protect_spec.txt D02/D04-D07/K02/K03b
#   exactly (RS02 etc. are byte-identical to the existing `#>` rows). NOTHING WAS RUN ON A REAL xterm; the xterm column is read from source, not observed.
#
# SOURCES
#   [XT-ctl] https://invisible-island.net/xterm/ctlseqs/ctlseqs.html  DECERA `CSI Pt;Pl;Pb;Pr $ z` "VT400 and up"; DECFRA `CSI Pc;Pt;Pl;Pb;Pr $ x` "VT420 and up";
#            DECCRA `CSI Pt;Pl;Pb;Pr;Pp;Pt;Pl;Pp $ v` "VT400 and up"; DECSERA `CSI Pt;Pl;Pb;Pr $ {`; DECSACE `CSI Ps * x` Note 1: "In both stream and rectangle modes
#            the row- and column- positions are affected by Origin Mode". ctlseqs lists NO defaults for any of them.
#   [XT-cp]  xterm charproc.c (ThomasDickey/xterm-snapshots master) CASE_DECCRA L5648, CASE_DECERA L5657, CASE_DECFRA L5666, CASE_DECSERA L5686: all four are gated on
#            `screen->vtXX_level >= 4`; DECFRA additionally on `IsLatin1(value) || (value >= 256 && CharWidth(value) > 0)`; value = use_default_value(0, ' ').
#   [XT-scr] xterm screen.c L2587-2700 minRect/maxRect, limitedParseRow/Col, xtermParseRect, validRect; ScrnFillRectangle L2681 (DECERA+DECFRA); ScrnCopyRectangle L2800;
#            ScrnWipeRectangle L3095 (DECSERA).  ptyx.h ATTRIBUTES = SGR_MASK|SGR_MASK2|BG_COLOR|FG_COLOR|INVISIBLE|PROTECTED.
#   [DEC-ERA] https://vt100.net/docs/vt510-rm/DECERA.html  [DEC-FRA] .../DECFRA.html  [DEC-CRA] .../DECCRA.html  [DEC-SERA] .../DECSERA.html  [DEC-SACE] .../DECSACE.html
#   [E2]     esctest2 esctest/tests/{deccra,decera,decfra,decsera,decrectops,save_restore_cursor,scorc}.py
#   [ADR34]  docs/adr/0034-protected-areas-and-selective-erase.md;  [LEAD] the planning decisions in the #251 issue comment (2026-11-12).
#   DEC STD 070 (VSRM EL-00070-05, pages 5-170 DECFRA, 5-173 DECCARA, 5-175 DECRARA, 5-177 DECSACE) is not online; xterm's source comments quote it.
#
# WHAT THE ISSUE TEXT / EXISTING FILES GET WRONG OR LEAVE OPEN
#   1. "gate at conformance level 4" is right: all four xterm handlers test `vtXX_level >= 4` and the VT510 pages say "VT Level 4 mode only". DECSED/DECSEL/DECSCA are NOT gated (D09 note).
#   2. The VT510 DECCRA page's own wording is "If Pbs is greater than Pts, or Pls is greater than Prs, the terminal ignores DECCRA" (letters swapped in the manual); read it as
#      Pts > Pbs / Pls > Prs. xterm/esctest2 agree (validRect).
#   3. protect_spec.txt D01-D10 are correct against this model except: D10 only checks bg; D-P7 should also keep fg and SGR flags (RS10). D06 is `>   |`, D09 `>abc |` per the lead.
#   4. protect_spec.txt trailer says "xterm's DECERA ignores protection and DECFRA/DECERA stamp the pen's PROTECTED bit": true of xterm for BOTH (xw->flags & ATTRIBUTES),
#      but the lead decided DECERA never stamps it (RE17-RE19); only DECFRA does (RF22) -- see open question Q1.
#   5. DECSERA row K03b is right; the issue says D01-D10 + K02/K03 DECSERA forms (K03b).
#   6. ctlseqs gives no parameter defaults; the defaults (1,1,last,last; dest 1,1; page 1) come ONLY from the VT510 pages and are what xterm implements.
#
# XTERM vs DEC DIFFERENCES THAT THESE ROWS FIX A SIDE ON (all marked `xterm-differs`)
#   X1 DECERA with a default pen: DEC "erases ... visual attributes" (blank); xterm keeps the cell's old colours (keepColors=True) and stamps the pen's bold/underline/PROTECTED. RE17-RE19.
#   X2 DECOM + omitted rectangle parameter: xterm passes the already-absolute default through limitedParseRow/Col which adds the margin again (default top becomes top_marg*2+1).
#      Real xterm bug (affects DECERA/DECFRA/DECSERA/DECCRA source+dest). RO03, RO09. [LEAD]: no double count.
#   X3 DECFRA with a wide Pch: xterm writes the wide codepoint into single cells without spacers (corrupt line). RF14.
#   X4 DECCRA/DECFRA/DECERA at a wide-char edge: xterm's source copy carries a raw HIDDEN_CHAR spacer to the destination (orphan); erase/fill blank both halves. RW07.
#   X5 DECCRA in DECOM: xterm clips the DESTINATION to the origin region (margin box); the DEC text says it clips "off-page data" (the page). RO10, RO11.
#   X6 DECFRA Pch 128-159: xterm accepts them when c1_printable is set; Tessera has no such option. RF09.
#   X7 DECSERA with ISO (SPA/EPA) protection: xterm erases (mode != DEC_PROTECT); ED/EL/ECH/DECSED/DECSEL honour it. Not a DEC/xterm difference but the one DECSERA oddity. RS07.
#
# OTHER EMULATORS (not row-tested)  iTerm2: none of DECERA/DECFRA/DECCRA/DECSERA implemented except as no-ops (esctest2 knownBug "Not implemented", some "Erase fills rather than clears").
#   kitty: not implemented. Alacritty: not implemented. WezTerm: parses, no rectangle ops. VTE: DECERA/DECFRA/DECCRA/DECSERA implemented partially (no DECSERA protection), not authoritative.
#   (from esctest2 knownBug annotations and prior #95 research; kitty/Alacritty/WezTerm not re-fetched for this issue.)
#
# OPEN QUESTIONS (details at the end of the file; each has the recommended row already in place)
#   Q1 DECFRA stamps the pen's PROTECTED bit (RF22; xterm does; DEC silent) -- changes the ADR 0034 "blank cells never carry the bit" sentence.
#   Q2 DECCRA in DECOM: clip the destination to the origin region (xterm, RO10/RO11) or only to the page (DEC text)?
#   Q3 DECCRA/DECERA/DECSERA and OSC 8 hyperlinks on cells (no xterm precedent): see Q3 in the closing section.
#   Q4 DECFRA Pch U+FFFF (parameter saturation) and charset mapping of Pch via GL/GR (RF17, RF25).
#   Q5 The `CSI * x` DECSACE sequence: not needed for #251 (RH01); DECCARA/DECRARA are out of scope.
# =============================================================================

# ============================================================================================================
# A. DECERA  CSI Pt;Pl;Pb;Pr $ z   (level >= 4; esctest2 decera.py -> decrectops.py FillRectangleTests)
# ============================================================================================================

# =============================================================================
# PROPERTY ROWS (no screen; one test each, not fixture cases)
#   B01 allocation bound   [docs/security.md]  DECCRA with a 65535x65535 request on a RxC screen allocates at most R*C cells (the source is clamped first); no Vec sized from a
#       parameter. xterm allocates `high*wide` after validRect (screen-sized too). Same for DECFRA/DECERA/DECSERA: zero allocation.
#   B02 work bound         one rectangle op touches at most R*C cells; 100_000 full-screen DECCRA on 24x80 must finish inside the existing perf budget of tests/*_alloc.rs style tests.
#   B03 chunking           every row above runs whole and byte by byte (the shared harness does this) -- including a split inside `$` and inside a multi-digit parameter.
#   B04 no side effects    after any of the four ops: cursor, pending wrap, pen, DECSCA mode, saved cursor, scrollback, selection, hyperlink table, OSC 133 marks, tab stops,
#       margins, modes unchanged. Rows RE20/RE21/RE22/RF24/RC20/RC21/RS15 prove the visible ones; B04 asserts the rest structurally ([LEAD]: marks untouched).
#   B05 damage             only rows intersecting the (clamped) rectangle are damaged (render golden); a no-op (invalid rect, level < 4) damages nothing.
#   B06 DA1                attribute 28 (rectangular editing) NOT added ([LEAD]). xterm CASE_DA1 reports 28 at `terminal_id >= 400`; Tessera must not claim it until DECCARA/DECRARA/
#       DECRQCRA exist, else vim/tmux would use them. A test pins the current DA1 string.
#   B07 reset              RIS and DECSTR do not need new state (no new mode), except that DECSTR does not clear the screen: unchanged.
#
# DECISIONS ALREADY MADE BY THE LEAD (rows follow them)  DECERA blank = pen background only, never PROTECTED (RE17-19); DECFRA takes the full pen style (RF20-22);
#   DECSERA keeps colours/SGR/PROTECTED (RS10, RS11); DECOM relative+clamped, no default double count (RO*); page parameters accepted and ignored (RC13-RC15); DECFRA Pch 0/absent = space,
#   1-31 and 127-159 ignored, >= 256 only if width 1 (RF03-RF17); a wide char cut by an edge is blanked whole (RW*); wrapped flag, marks, pending wrap untouched (RE21, RE22, RC21, B04);
#   colon sub-parameter voids the sequence (RE13); level >= 4 (RG*).
#
# DECISIONS NEEDED FROM THE LEAD (each one changes a row; recommendation first)
#   Q1  DECFRA copies the pen's PROTECTED bit (xterm; RF22) vs never (consistent with DECERA). Recommend: copy (DECFRA is a write like printing, ADR 0034 "printing copies the pen bit").
#   Q2  DECCRA in DECOM clips the destination to the origin region (xterm; RO10/RO11) vs the page. Recommend: xterm (source and destination both live in the origin region).
#   Q3  Hyperlink ids on cells: DECCRA copies the id with the cell; DECERA/DECSERA/DECFRA(blank) clear it. Recommend that. No fixture row (needs OSC 8 in the harness); add one to the PR tests.
#   Q4  DECFRA Pch >= 256 that is a noncharacter (U+FFFF from a saturated parameter): ignore (recommend) or fill. And map Pch 32-126 through the active GL charset (RF25, recommend yes: DEC says
#       "the character in the current GL or GR in-use table") or fill raw ASCII.
#   Q5  Default state: `conformance_level >= 4` is true by default in Tessera (margins_spec.txt header). Confirm DECSCL 61-63 must make all four ops no-ops and that DECSCL 64/65 restore them (RG*).
#
# DONE-WHEN impact: (a) the issue lists D01-D10, K02, K03b only; the new rows RE*, RF*, RC*, RO*, RW* are the DECERA/DECFRA/DECCRA coverage the issue title promises but its "Done when"
#   does not enumerate; (b) D10 and RS10 differ: D-P7 must keep fg+SGR too, not only bg; (c) Q1-Q4 above each need a one-line ADR 0046 sentence; (d) the issue says "gate at level 4"
#   but does not say DECSCL <4 must keep screen content (RG*): rows assume it does.
# =============================================================================
